s: Din hambashshel beshabbat ubo l"a seipim: hambashshel beshabbat, o sheasa achat mishshear melakot bemezid — asur lo leolam lehanot meotah melaka, mishshum qenas. Vegam haqqedera shebbishshel bah asura lo leolam, mippene shehi belua middabar haasur lo. Abal laacherim — muttar ap hattabshil bemotzae shabbat miyyad, veen tzerikim lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, ap im bishshel bishbilam. Shello hitzriku lehamtin ken ella benokri haoseh bishbil yisrael, sheim nattir lo lehanot bemotzae shabbat miyyad — yesh lachush shemma yomar lo laasot beshabbat, kede sheyyihyeh haddabar mukan lo bemotzae shabbat miyyad, sheissur haamira lenokri qal beene habberiyyot. Veken apillu beyisrael haoseh, ella shehitchil mibbeod yom asiyyato bedabar sheasur lehatchil, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"g, sheissur zeh gam ken qal beene habberiyyot, veyesh lachush sheyyaabor alayv bishbil sheyyehe mukan lo bemotzae shabbat miyyad, velaken hitzriku lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu gam laacherim, gezera shemma yomru leacher sheyyatchil lahem mibbeod yom. Abal en lachush kelal shemma yomar leyisrael laasot lo melaka beshabbat bishbil lehanot mimmenna bemotzae shabbat miyyad. Veod, shehayyisrael lo yishma lo, she"en adam chote velo lo". Veken im haya shogeg — asur bo bayyom gam laacherim, shekkevan sheasa issur shel tora — hechemiru liqnos bo bayyom kemo bemezid sheasur gam laacherim, gezera shemma yebashshel bemezid veyomar "shogeg hayiti". Abal laereb muttar gam lo miyyad, veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, mittaam shennitbaer:
Im asa al pi horaat chakam shettaa — niqra shogeg. Vehu haddin hashshokeach shehu shabbat o shehi melaka:

Im chal yom tob bemotzae shabbat — asur ad motzae yom tob, mippene sheen shabbat mekina leyom tob. Veyesh omerim sheen hakana shayyak bazeh, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tq"a. Veyesh lachush lisbara harishona:

Im bishshel bemezid venitareb hattabshil bemotzae shabbat betabshilin acherim — batel berob. Veeno niqra "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", dehaynu sheepshar laacherim leekol hattaarobot hazzeh behetter gamur shello mechamat bittul berob, mippene sheeno niqra "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" ella kesheyyesh tzad hetter lemi shenneesar lo, abal kan en hetter belo bittul berob ella laacherim, shello neesar lahem kelal mimmotzae shabbat veelak. Abal im nitareb beshabbat, kevan shebbo bayyom chal alayv shem "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" legabbe acherim sheen batel lahem berob — chal alayv shem "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" gam legabbe hambashshel, veneesar lo hattaarobot hazzeh leolam:

Hashshochet beshabbat lecholeh sheyyesh bo sakkana — muttar habbari leekol mimmennu chay ubelo melicha, ella bahadacha bilbad, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman s"z, lepi sheasur limloach beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"a. Vaapillu chala hacholeh hayyom, veetmol lo haya bedato kelal sheyyishchat hayyom — ap al pi ken en bah mishshum muqtzeh, mittaam shennitbaer besiman sh"y. Abal hambashshel o asa shear melaka bishbil hacholeh sheyyesh bo sakkana — asur beshabbat labbari o lecholeh sheen bo sakkana, gezera shemma yarbeh bimlakto bishbilo. Mah sheen ken bishchita sheen bah leharbot bishbil habbari, shehare i epshar lekazzayit basar shetztzarik lehacholeh belo shechitat kol habbehema. Vaapillu asa al yede nokri, ben letzorek choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana, ben letzorek choleh sheen bo sakkana — asur labbari beshabbat, gezera shemma yarbeh bishbilo. Abal lemotzae shabbat muttar labbari miyyad, veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, kevan shehannokri asa behetter letzorek choleh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishar melakot, chutz meapiyya ubishshul, sheim apa nokri o bishshel beshabbat letzorek choleh — asur labbari ap bemotzae shabbat mishshum bishshule nokrim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qy"g:

Haqqotzetz peri shello nigmar bishshulo lecholeh beshabbat — asur labbari mishshum muqtzeh, apillu chala mibbeod yom vehaya kebar bedato mibbeod yom liqtzotz happeri beshabbat, mippene sheen hakana moelet kelal bimchubbar bekayyotze bazeh, shehu gadel veholek beshabbat. Abal peri shennigmar bishshulo veshub eno gadel veholek — moelet bo hakana ap al pi shehu mechubbar:

Hambashshel hu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu mebashshelim samemanim litzboa bah. Velo bishshul bammayim bilbad, ella ap hattiggun vehaapiyya vehatztzeliyya hen biklal bishshul. Veken kol mi sherippa gup qasheh beur, kegon hammattik echad mimmine mattakot, o hamchammem et hammatteket ad shennaasa gachelet, veken hamemasses hashshaava o hacheleb o hazzepet vehaggoprit beur, o shehiqsha gup rak beur, kegon hammanniach keli adama beur ad shennaasu keli cheres — chayyab mishshum mebashshel. Ukeshem sheasur lebashshel beur — kak asur lebashshel betoledet haur, kegon litten betza betzad qedera shehuchamma beur, o leshabberah al hassudar shehucham beur kede shettitztzaleh meat. Veim nitzlet sham kemaakal ben derosai — chayyab mishshum mebashshel kemo betzoleh al haur. Vaapillu betoledet chamma, kegon besudar shehucham bachamma — asur, gezera mishshum toledot haur, sheharoeh sabur shehucham hassudar beur. Veken asur legalgelah al gabbe chol vaabaq derakim shehuchammu mikkoach chamma. Veasur lehatminah bahem apillu mibbeod yom, gezera shemma yatmin beremetz, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"z. Abal bachamma atzmah, kegon litten betza bachamma kede shettitztzaleh, o litten mayim bachamma kede sheyyuchammu — muttar, mippene sheen derek bishshul bekak. Veen ligzor al chamma mishshum ur, mippene shechamma enah mitchallepet beur:

Hambashshel bechamme teberya — patur, mippene shehen ketoledet chamma. Abal asur middibre soperim, apillu im hattabshil omed al gabbayv umitbashshel milmala. Abal muttar lehaamidam sham mibbeod yom, abal lehatmino kullo betokam — asur apillu mibbeod yom, mishshum issur hatmana, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"v:

Kol dabar lach yesh bo bishshul achar bishshul. Dehaynu, tabshil lach shennitbashshel kebar kol tzorko venitztannen, vaapillu lo nitztannen legamre ella sheen hayyad soledet bo, vechimmemo beshabbat ad shehayyad soledet bo — chayyab mishshum mebashshel. Abal im hu cham kol kak ad shehayyad soledet bo umarticho yoter — en bazeh mishshum bishshul. Umuttar apillu lekattechilla leharticho samuk laesh bemaqom sheen lachush lechittuy, kemo sheyyitbaer (veim muttar litteno al gabbe kira o tannur — nitbaer besiman rn"g). Veyesh omerim sheapillu nitztannen legamre — en bishshul achar bishshul. Umuttar leharticho beshabbat samuk laesh, bemaqom sheen lachush lechittuy. Venahagu lehaqel im lo nitztannen legamre, ella rauy adayin leekol mechamat chamimuto. Abal im nitztannen legamre — nohagin kasbara harishona apillu leinyan diabad, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"g. Vaapillu litteno al tannur bet hachorep qodem shemmassiqo hannokri, kede sheyyitchammem kesheyyassiqennu — asur, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veken bekol dabar sheyyitbaer sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul:

Vekol zeh betabshil shennitbashshel kol tzorko, abal kol shello nitbashshel kol tzorko, apillu nitbashshel kebar kemaakal ben derosai — yesh bo mishshum bishshul, apillu beodo roteach. Vaapillu yitbashshel meelayv, ella sheoseh dabar shemmeqareb bishshulo, kegon shemmegiso bekap:

Tabshil yabesh sheen bo roteb kelal — en bo bishshul achar bishshul, im nitbashshel kebar kol tzorko, vaapillu nitztannen legamre. Umuttar apillu lishroto bikli rishon roteach kede sheyyehe nimmoach sham veyihyeh dabar lach. Veim hu dabar yabesh shello nitbashshel millipne hashshabbat — en shorin oto beshabbat bechammin shehayyad soledet bo, apillu eno nimmoach sham kelal. Veim shara bikli rishon — chayyab. Ubikli sheni asur lishroto middibre soperim, mippene shennireh kimbashshel. Veeno domeh litbalin shemmuttar littenam bikli sheni kemo sheyyitbaer, mippene shehattebalin asuyin lematteq haqqedera, veeno nireh kimbashshel. Veken kol dabar heasuy litten taam biqdera, kegon shum ubatzal — hare hem kitbalin, umuttar littenam bikli sheni ap al pi shehayyad soledet bo. Veyesh mi shemmistappeq bebatzal, shemma hu mitbashshel gam bikli sheni kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo. Venahagu lehaqel. Veyesh mattirin bekol dabar yabesh shello nitbashshel lishroto bikli sheni shehayyad soledet bo. Veyesh lehachamir bazeh kasbara harishona. Abal muttar laarot mikkeli sheni shehayyad soledet bo al kol dabar yabesh shello nitbashshel, chutz mimmin dag shenniqra "qulyas haispanin", umaliach hayyashan, dehaynu basar o dag maluach shel shana sheobra, sheellu enam tzerikim bishshul ella meat, veeruy zeh hi gemar meleket bishshulan, vechayyab alayv mishshum mebashshel. Abal muttar lishrotan velahadichan bemayim tzonenim. Veken kol dabar qasheh shello nitbashshel, sheeno rauy laakila ki im al yede sheriyya o hadacha bechammin, im shara oto apillu bikli sheni, o hedicho apillu beeruy mikkeli sheni, venaasa rauy — chayyab mishshum mebashshel. Veken kol dabar sheeno mebushshal, shehu maluach harbeh, veeno rauy laakila ki im al yede sheriyya o hadacha bechammin, im shara o hediach bechammin — chayyab. Abal muttar lishroto velahadicho betzonenin, vaapillu naaseh rauy al yede kak, shekkol dabar sheeno okel muttar laasoto okel beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"d:

Yesh mi sheomer, sheap al pi sheen bishshul achar bishshul bedabar yabesh, mikkol maqom yesh bishshul achar apiyya o tzeliyya, shehaapuy o hatztzaluy, im netano, apillu beodo roteach, betok keli rishon shehayyad soledet bo — chayyab. Ulepi zeh gam bikli sheni yesh lehachamir middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello litten pat apuya apillu biqara shehi keli sheni, kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo. Veyesh mi shemmistappeq vechoshesh mechiyyub chattat gam bikli sheni shehayyad soledet bo, mippene sheyyesh debarim rakkim shemmitbashshelim gam bikli sheni, veen anu beqiin bahen, veshemma gam hallechem niqra rak leinyan zeh umitbashshel gam bikli sheni shehayyad soledet bo. Veken yesh lehistappeq sapeq zeh gam bishar debarim. Veyesh lehachamir bekullan, lebad mibbitbalin, shehittiru chakamim beperush littenam bikli sheni, veken mayim veshemen, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vehu haddin lishar mashqin. Vaapillu bebasar tzaluy yesh lehachamir, kevan sheyyesh bishshul achar tzeliyya. Abal bimbushshal en lehachamir kelal, apillu bikli rishon, shelledibre hakkol en bishshul achar bishshul bedabar yabesh. Abal yesh mattirin beapuy vetzaluy, apillu tzonenim, littenam apillu betok keli rishon roteach, mippene sheen bishshul apillu achar apiyya utzeliyya. Venahagu lizzaher lekattechilla kasbara harishona, shello litten pat apillu bikli sheni kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo. Abal bediabad yesh lehattir apillu bikli rishon kasbara haacharona:

Ulepi sebara harishona sheyyesh bishshul achar apiyya utzeliyya — yesh gam ken apiyya utzeliyya achar bishshul, dehaynu shekkol dabar hambushshal asur litteno belo roteb samuk laesh, bemaqom sheyyakol lehitchammem sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Abal ledibre hakkol en apiyya utzeliyya achar apiyya utzeliyya, vedabar haapuy o tzaluy muttar litteno samuk laesh al derek sheyyitbaer, apillu nitztannen kebar legamre:

Keli sheyyesh bo dabar cham shehayyad soledet bo — muttar lehannicho beshabbat al gabbe qedera hattemuna babbegadim kede sheyyishmor chummo velo yitztannen. Vaapillu lo nitbashshel kol tzorko, sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul kesheoseh dabar shemmemaher ligmor bishshulo, mikkol maqom kan i epshar lo kelal labo lide bishshul gamur, velo apillu lide hosapat bishshul, ella lehaamid chummo bilbad. Umuttar latuach piv bebatzeq kede lehaamid chummo, im yesh lo batzeq shennillosh meetmol. Abal asur lehatmino tachat habbegadim, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"g:

Abal en mannichin keli sheyyesh bo dabar sheeno cham kol kak ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, al gabbe qedera shehi chamma kol kak shehaelyon yakol lehitchammem mechummah ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, vehu haddin al gabbe mecham shehu cham kol kak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaelyon lo nitbashshel adayin kol tzorko, sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul ap keshehu cham. Abal im nitbashshel kebar kol tzorko, ella shennitztannen meat, ap al pi sheeno cham kol kak shehayyad soledet bo, kevan shehu cham qetzat ad shehu rauy leekol mechamat chamimuto — kebar nitbaer shennohagin lehaqel sheen bo mishshum bishshul, umuttar lehannicho al gabbe qedera o al gabbe mecham lechammemo harbeh. Veim hu dabar yabesh shennitbashshel kol tzorko, apillu nitztannen legamre — en bo mishshum bishshul, umuttar lechammemo al gabbehen apillu shettehe hayyad soledet bo:

Vaapillu im haqqedera temuna al gabbe haesh, kegon al gabbe kira sheenah gerupa uqetuma, al pi hadderakim shennitbaaru besiman rn"g, veken mecham sheal gabbe haesh — muttar litten alehen beshabbat kol dabar sheen bo mishshum bishshul, kegon tabshil yabesh apillu hu tzonen legamre, o tabshil lach shello nitztannen legamre, mittaam shennitbaer besiman rn"g:

Keli rishon, apillu leachar sheheebiruhu meal haur, mebashshel kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo. Lepikak, asur litten letoko tebalin. Vetob limnoa millatet tebalin bikli rishon apillu en hayyad soledet bo, kede laasot harchaqa useyag laddabar. Abal melach muttar litten betoko, kevan sheheebiro meal haesh, shehammelach tzarik bishshul rab kemo besar shor, veeno mitbashshel ella al haesh. Umikkol maqom, besar shor asur litten bikli rishon, sheap shehabbasar eno mitbashshel, mikkol maqom hallachluchit shealayv mitbashshel, ella im ken shehu yabesh sheen alayv lachluchit kelal. Veyesh omerim shehammelach eno tzarik bishshul ella meat, veasur litteno ap bikli sheni kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo. Vehammachmir tabo alayv beraka. Veim abar venatan melach apillu bikli rishon, apillu hu al haesh sheasa issur — hammaakal muttar, lepi shehammelach batel neged hammaakal. Veyesh choleqim, veoserim ad motzae shabbat:

Vekol zeh bemelach sheeno mebushshal, abal melach shellanu shemmetaqqenim oto al yede bishshul bammayim — muttar litteno bikli rishon ledibre hakkol, sheen bishshul achar bishshul bedabar yabesh, apillu hu nimmoach al yede bishshul zeh hashsheni, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, hammachmir bo kemo bishar melach — tabo alayv beraka:

Asur litten tebalin biqara velaarot alehem mikkeli rishon shehayyad soledet bo, mippene sheeruy mikkeli rishon mebashshel kede qelipa. Veim era — azay haqqelipa asura, mippene shennitbashshela beshabbat. Abal im era techilla mehakkeli rishon letok haqqeara — muttar litten achar kak hattebalin laqqeara, mippene shechom keli sheni en bo koach lebashshel. Vaapillu lehammachmirim bikli sheni leinyan issur vehetter, shessoberim sheyyesh bo koach lehablia ulehaplit kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo, mikkol maqom en bo koach lebashshel ap al pi shehayyad soledet bo. Veeno domeh likli rishon shemmebashshel kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo, lepi shekkeli rishon mittok sheomed (etzel haesh) al haur — dopnotayv chammin umachaziq chummo harbeh, ulekak natenu bo shiur kol zeman shehayyad soledet bo, mah sheen ken bikli sheni sheen dopnotayv chammin veholek umitqarer:

Ambatti shel merchatz shehi melea mayim chammin, ap al pi shehi keli sheni — asur laarot letokah mayim tzonenim, shekkevan shehachammin shebbah hen lirchitza — min hassetam hen chammin meod, venitbashshelim hatztzonenim shemmitorbin bahen. Abal muttar litten mehachammin shebbazo haambatti letok ambatti acheret shel tzonen. Vaapillu mikkeli rishon muttar laarot letok mayim tzonenim, shello ameru sheeruy mikkeli rishon mebashshel, ella bimareh chammin al gabbe tebalin vekayyotze bahen, sheen hachammin mitorbin mammash betokan, ella makkin alehem beqilluchan umebashshelin, abal mayim bemayim shemmitorbim mammash — en koach beqilluach lebashshel mayim hattachtonim, ella hattachtonim goberim umetzannenayim et haelyonim. Abal asur litten chatikat basar cham shehayyad soledet bo letok roteb tzonen, shekkevan sheeno mitareb mammash baroteb — hare hu mebashshel kede qelipa sebibo terem sheyyitgabber alayv haroteb vitzanneno:

Mecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim chammin — asur litten letoko mayim tzonenin muatin sheyyekolin lehitchammem sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Abal muttar litten letoko mayim tzonenim merubbim kede lehapshiran. Veap al pi sheal yede netinat hatztzonen letoko hu metzorpo umachaziqo, venimtza metaqqen keli, shekken derek tzorepe nechoshet ubarzel shemmannichim barzel unechoshet chammim letok mayim tzonenim bishbil sheyyitqashshu veyitchazzequ, vezo hi gemar meleket hatztzorepim, shehaur mepapea hammatteket veqarob lehishshaber vehammayim machaziqin oto, mikkol maqom, kevan sheeno mitkavven letiqqun hakkeli ella lehapshir hammayim — muttar, sheen kan "pesiq resheh velo yamut", mippene shekkeshemmetzorpin hakkeli mechammemin oto techilla beyoter, abal kan epshar shello yaggia letzerup, mippene shehammayim moneim oto millehitchammem kol kak:

Muttar laarot mayim tzonenim apillu muatim letok mayim chammin shehayyad soledet bo shebbikli sheni, abal lo letok chammin shebbikli rishon. Veim hatztzonenim merubbim kol kak shei epshar sheyyitchammemu ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, raq sheyyapigu tzinnatan — muttar apillu letok keli rishon, ubilbad shello yihyeh al haesh:

Muttar lehaamid qiton shel mayim o shel shear mashqin tzonenim betok keli sheni sheyyesh bo mayim chammin (vaapillu lehatmino kullo betokah, shemmuttar lehatmin et hatztzonen bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"z, vehachammin hen niqraim dabar sheeno mosip hebel, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"ch). Abal bikli rishon asur lehaamido apillu lehapig tzinnato bilbad, gezera shemma yishkach veyishtaheh sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Vaapillu beambatti shehumsheku letokah chamme teberya min hammayan — asur lehaamido betokah, mippene shehi kikli rishon middibre soperim, ella yittol mehaambatti bikli sheni veyaamidennu betoko:

Muttar litten qiton shel mayim o shear mashqin keneged hammedura lehapig tzinnatan, ubilbad sheyyittenem rachoq mehaesh, beinyan sheenan yekolin lehitchammem beoto maqom ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, ap im yishheh sham zeman merubbeh. Abal asur littenam samuk laesh bemaqom sheyyekolin lehitchammem sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Vaapillu lehannichan sham shaa muetet shettapig tzinnatan bilbad — asur, gezera shemma yishkachem veyishhu sham ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Vehu haddin perot o shear debarim hanneekalin kemot shehen chayyin, sheap sheenam tzerikim bishshul, mikkol maqom im nitbashshelu — chayyab. Lepikak asur lehannicham bemaqom sheyyekolin lehitbashshel im yishhu sham zeman merubbeh, dehaynu bemaqom sheyyekolin lehitchammem ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo. Abal kol dabar sheen bo mishshum bishshul — muttar apillu leharticho keneged hammedura, kegon tabshil lach shennitbashshel kol tzorko veodennu cham shehayyad soledet bo, o apillu en hayyad soledet bo ella shello nitztannen legamre, lepi hamminhag shennitbaer lemala shennahagu lehaqel bazeh, o apillu nitztannen legamre ella shehu dabar haapuy o tzaluy, veen apiyya utzeliyya achar apiyya utzeliyya apillu nitztannen legamre, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, lo hittiru ella keneged hammedura, abal asur litteno al haesh mammash, o apillu besamuk lah mammash, ella tzarik leharchiq qetzat, ki yesh lachush shemma yishkach shehu shabbat veyabo lachtot begechalim. Abal kesheanu matzrikim oto leharchiq qetzat — yesh lo bazeh hekker vezikkaron velo yabo lachtot begechalim:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar lechammem haapuy? Kesheen bo shumman, abal pat kepula sheyyesh betokah chatikot shumman shenniqrash (sheqqorin aynpand"h) — asur lehachem otah apilu rachoq min haesh maqom sheen hayyad soledet bo, vaapillu lehannichah bachamma, mippene shehashshumman shebbah shenniqrash chozer venimmoach, vahare zeh domeh limrasseq chatikat barad bishbil sheyyazubu memayv, sheaseru chakamim mippene shemmolid beshabbat, vedomeh limlaka shebbore mayim hallalu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"k. Vehu haddin leshumman hannimmoach. Vaapillu bediabad asur mah shennimmoach beshabbat, kemo mashqin shezzabu beshabbat mipperot haomedim lemashqin, sheasurim mishshum gezera shemma yischot happerot, kevan shehem omedim lekak, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Veap shumman zeh, kevan sheddarko lihyot zab vetzalul, lepikak keshehu qarush hare hu keperot haomedim lemashqin, vehazzab mimmennu beshabbat — asur ad laereb:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennimmoach shumman harbeh kol kak ad sheyyazub lachutz, vahare hu been lebaddo, sheeno meorab beshum dabar ella hu nikkar bipne atzmo. Abal im mannichah berichuq maqom kol kak beinyan sheen harbeh shumman nimmoach ad sheyyazub lachutz, ella meat mimmennu nimmoach venibla bappat atzmo, veeno been lebad — muttar apillu lekattechilla. Kemo shemmuttar litten chatikat barad letok kos shel yayin, ap al pi shehabbarad nimcheh lesham, mippene shehu mitareb umitbattel bayyayin shebbakkos veeno been, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Vaapillu im miqtzato zab lachutz meat veyeshno been, kevan sheddabar muat hu — eno chashub kelum, umuttar. Velaken muttar lehachem beshabbet chatikat basar shamen, ap al pi shemmiqtzato zab, kevan sheddabar muat hu. Abal asur lehachem qedera sheqqarash shamnunitah, apillu bemaqom sheen hayyad soledet bo, veap al pi sheyyesh bah roteb harbeh venimmoach hashshumman betok haroteb, mikkol maqom hashshumman hu tzap lemala veyeshno been:

Abal yesh choleqim al kol zeh, veomerim sheen issur kelal bemah shennimmoach hashshumman al yede shemmannicho bemaqom cham. Velo aseru gabbe chatikat barad ella lerasseq beyadayim, abal benimmoach meelayv lo gazeru. Velaken muttar lehachem pat zo hamemullet beshumman apillu bemaqom shehayyad soledet bo, shehare en kan mishshum bishshul, lo bappat, mippene sheen apiyya achar apiyya, velo bashshumman haqqarush shennimmoach, mippene sheen bishshul achar bishshul bedabar yabesh ap al pi shennimmoach bebishshul zeh hashsheni, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal qedera sheqqarash shamnunitah — en lehachem otah ella bemaqom shello yukal hattabshil lehitchammem ad shettehe hayyad soledet bo, mippene shebbaroteb shennitztannen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Uleinyan halaka nahagu lehachamir lekattechilla kasbara harishona, abal bediabad yesh lehaqel kasbara haacharona. Vaapillu lekattechilla yesh lismok bimqom hatztzorek al sebara haacharona, ki ken iqqar. Veken yesh lehaqel litten pat hamemullet beshumman al tannur bet hachorep qodem shehussaq, ukesheyyassiqennu hannokri gam hi titchammem alayv, lepi sheapillu leinyan issur bishshul bedabar sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul — en bazeh issur min hattora ella middibre soperim, kevan shennoten sham qodem sheyyitten hannokri et haur battannur, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"g, im ken kan sheyyesh mattirin legamre — yesh lehaqel al kol panim qodem shehussaq hattannur. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel bipne am haaretz, veyesh laasot al yede nokri:

Uledibre hakkol muttar litten shumman mehuttak shenniqrash al gabbe mine qemachim veqitniyyot rotechim, ubilbad shello yerasseqennu beyadayim, ella yannichennu al gabbehen o betokan vehu nimmoach meelayv, shehare mah shenimmoach eno been ella niknas betokan. Abal al gabbe tzali cham — yesh lehistappeq im muttar litten alayv shumman qarush sheyyehe nimmoach meelayv, shekkevan sheen hannimmoach niknas betoko ella tzap al gabbayv — yesh ledammoto liqdera sheqqarash shamnunitah shennohagin lehachamir lekattechilla:

Asur litten tzonen al hammecham apillu lehapshir, kol shehammecham cham kol kak sheillu haya hatztzonen munnach alayv harbeh haya ba lide bishshul, dehaynu shettehe hayyad soledet bo, sheddin manniach al gabbe mecham kedin manniach keneged hammedura. Abal im eno cham kol kak — muttar:

Hailpas vehaqqedera sheheebiran meruttachin meal gabbe haur, im enan mebushshalin kol tzorkan — lo yotzi mehem bekap, shennimtza megis, veyesh bazeh mishshum bishshul, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im nitbashshelu kol tzorkan — muttar lehagis bahen leachar sheheebiran meal gabbe haur. Abal tzemer shebbayyora, ap al pi sheqqalat haayin — asur lehagis bo (mishshum tzobea), shekken derek hatztzabbain lehagis bo tamid kede shello yecharek. Veyesh machmirin gam biqdera bekol inyan. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Veharotzeh lehachamir — yachmir bahagasa mammash. Abal lehotzi bekap — en lehachamir kelal benitbashshela kol tzorkah veenah al haesh:

Asur latuach shemen veshum al gabbe hatztzali beodo cham shehayyad soledet bo, apillu nitzla mibbeod yom, demikkol maqom yitbashshel hashshum vehashshemen. Abal shumman shenniqrash — en bo mishshum bishshul, ella sheyyesh lehistappeq bo mitztzad acher, kemo shennitbaer lemala:
